messages:
Ava: Morning team — tiny holiday experiment: desk "mini-snow" (fake snow + indoor-safe decorations) + gingerbread stall micro-market Friday? low-effort swaps welcome :snowflake::cookie:
Diego: love it. can we have a tidy rule? nothing adhesive on desks pls — leave sticky residue last year :grimacing:
Lian: I'll bring a box of faux snow puffs and some battery tea lights. 3pm setup ok?
Ravi: I'll bake a small batch of ginger snaps (gluten-free option) — recipe below if anyone wants to try:
```
ginger snaps (small):
- 1 cup flour (or gf blend)
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1/4 cup molasses
- 1 tsp ginger + 1/2 tsp cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
bake 10-12m at 350F
```
Cass: Can we do a tiny raffle for a holiday mug? I'll donate one. Vote poll?
FestivityBot: Poll created: "Do you want: mini-snow + gingerbread + raffle?" Options: :one: yes, :two: skip raffle, :three: only decorations, :four: remote-only hangout. Vote with emoji.
Diego: Voted :one: — also posting a pic of last year's disaster (lol) (photo)
Ava: Voted :one: — also adding 'no real snow' clause pls :laughing:
Lian: Voted :one: — confirm SF kitchen table at 3pm Friday for set up.
Ravi: Voted :one: — will label allergens on treats. Also quick PSA: bring tupperware for leftovers.
Cass: Voted :one: happy holidays already :sparkles:
